spans.text: Machine Learning Engineer with almost 5 years of experience building and deploying ML systems for security
threat detection at scale. Strong background in classical machine learning and deep learning, with hands-on
experience in data-driven modeling, feature engineering, model optimization, and production integration.
Designed, trained, and deployed ML models for real-time detection of cyber threats using CPU telemetry .
Built scalable feature engineering pipelines to transform high-volume telemetry data into model-ready signals, improving
Performed extensive model evaluation and tuning using ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall, F1-score, confusion matrix analysis,
and threshold/false-positive optimization to balance detection accuracy and reliability.
Optimized model performance through hyperparameter tuning and algorithm selection, leading to improved detection
Trained and evaluated models using AWS EC2, managed datasets on S3, and tracked experiments with DVC to ensure
Worked closely with security researchers and platform teams to translate threat research into deployable ML solutions.
Enhanced existing telemetry selection algorithms to better identify high-value features for security modeling, reducing
data collection overhead and improving model efficiency.
Applied continuous learning techniques to adapt telemetry selection strategies as new attack patterns emerged.
Built data processing pipelines to collect, clean, and aggregate telemetry across multiple hardware platforms.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate solutions into existing security frameworks.
Designed and implemented multiple Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate algorithmic, architectural, and code-level
Benchmarked alternative approaches and identified performance bottlenecks, leading to measurable improvements in
Collaborated closely with R&D Team to validate and integrate successful POCs into existing development
Worked with production-grade codebases, gaining hands-on experience in version control, debugging, and performance
Designed and implemented deep learning models for emotion and gender classification using image data.
Explored and evaluated different model architectures and training strategies to improve emotion classification
Conducted systematic experiments and performance evaluations across multiple emotion categories to validate model
Published the experimental findings in a research paper on arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.07746.
Programming & CS Fundamentals: Python, C++, Data Structures, Algorithms.
Machine Learning: Supervised & Unsupervised Learning, Regression, Classification, Random Forests,
Deep Learning: Neural Networks, CNN, RNN, LSTM, Attention Mechanisms.
Transformers & NLP: Transformer Architecture, BERT, Tokenization, Embeddings, TF-IDF, Word2Vec,
Model Evaluation & Optimization: ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall, F1-score, Hyperparameter Tuning,
Tools & Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers, Docker, AWS, DVC,
